raw_segments.text: On each soft side, coincident with the parted swell, that but once leaving him then flowed
so wide away, on each bright side, the whale shed off enticings.
No wonder there had been some among the hunters who namelessly transported and allured by
all this serenity, had ventured to assail it, but had fatally found that quietude but
Yet calm, enticing calm, oh whale!
Thou glidest on, to all who for the first time I thee, no matter how many in that same
way thou mayst he have bejuggled and destroyed before.
